_comment: sim-robust-cart-place-descent-v1. Purpose: let the COLLECT place onto the rollwagen deck COMPLETE (descent -> weld release -> stow to the transport pose) after the UPRIGHT preplace, so the honest collect stage ends with the carton on the cart. In collect2 the place had already reached the upright preplace over the deck (PR 209 collect_place_preplace_shape + collect_place_wrist_guard active) and the place-descent trajectory itself SUCCEEDED, but the mission-level stationary guard aborted the stage mid-descent: the extended, carton-loaded arm's descent reaction shoved the YAW-LOCK-ONLY braked base ~4 cm in translation (base x -4.518 -> -4.559), which flipped the 0.25 s windowed `parked` flag False for 3 ticks -> 'base moved during stationary operation'. The carton stayed held at z~0.606, the arm never stowed, and every re-begin then failed 'arm_not_in_transport_timeout'. These two keys make the sequence robust. BOTH absent/0 => byte-identical.
_runtime_block: Merge into the mission RUNTIME config block (read by scripts/twin/restock/isaac_bundle.py -> RuntimeAdapter, the orchestrate process).
_collect_place_base_settle_m_note: Metres. Tolerate a BOUNDED base excursion from the place_approach re-park anchor during the loaded collect place phases (transit/preplace/place/release/retreat/retreat_tuck/stow) instead of failing 'base moved during stationary operation' on the EXPECTED, re-settling place-descent reaction. collect2 shoved ~0.04 m; 0.08 covers it with margin and is far inside the 0.25 m ground-truth place-verify xy tol, so a tolerated shove still verifies carton-on-deck. A base pushed BEYOND this bound fails with a NAMED reason ('base pushed <x> m beyond the <tol> m collect-place settle tolerance by the loaded place-descent reaction') -- never a silent slide. Collect-only; absent => the strict guard (byte-identical). Validated in tests/test_restock_runtime.py (test_loaded_place_*).
_host_block: Merge into the mission HOST config block (restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json, read by ros_host.py -> TransferController).
_release_detach_timeout_s_note: SIM seconds. After the place descent the RELEASE emits a gripper-open and waits for the measured contact to clear (the SIM_ATTACH weld / suction to let go) before advancing to retreat/stow. If the weld fails to detach, fail FAST with a named reason ('release did not detach the held carton within <t>s sim of the gripper-open command (weld/suction still engaged)') instead of carrying the carton back up on retreat/stow or stalling to the coarse 120 s phase_timeout. SIM-clock (render-pacing-safe). 0/absent => rely on phase_timeout only (byte-identical). Clamped to <= phase_timeout. Validated in tests/test_restock_manipulation.py (test_release_*). Set modestly above the expected weld-detach settle; the place descent itself is slow, so a few sim-seconds is ample.
_requires: The HOST block must already carry the PR 209 upright place-goal keys (collect_place_preplace_shape + collect_place_wrist_guard) and reposition_before_place:true with cart_cage_place:false. Register collect_place_base_settle_m (RUNTIME) and release_detach_timeout_s (HOST) in the run's --require preflight (config_preflight knows them).
_bounded_gpu_proof: Run the collect2 config (GROUND-TRUTH collect, RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH=1, TRANSFER_MODE=scripted, cage_collision filtered, transfer_carry weld+wrist_guard, PR 203/208/209 keys) + couple, through scripts/run_mobile_restock.py under /tmp/aile-gpu.lock (HEAVY_MB=2500 for the always-on whispr), with collect_place_base_settle_m:0.08 merged into the RUNTIME block and release_detach_timeout_s:8.0 into the HOST block. Expected PASS: the place reaches the upright preplace as before, the place descent runs WITHOUT the stage aborting 'base moved during stationary operation' (the ~4 cm reaction is tolerated), the gripper-open DETACHES the weld, the ground-truth place verify shows the carton resting on the cart deck, the arm stows to the transport pose, and collect reports DONE (transport_ready becomes True so couple can begin). If the base is shoved more than 0.08 m the stage fails with the named settle-tolerance reason (raise the bound only if the ground-truth place still verifies on-deck); if the weld does not detach, the release fails fast with the named reason.
